guides.intro: What a Demonology warlock presses from level 1 to 60, stage by stage, as the trainer and the talent tree hand you new buttons. Demonology levels behind its demon: the Voidwalker (from 10) holds the mob, your dots and the demon's talents do the damage, and the wand fills every gap. From 28, **Searing Pain** brands the mob so the Voidwalker's hits deal extra damage. Each stage lists the full priority, so you can jump in at your level.

stages.title: Immolate, Shadow Bolt and the Imp
stages.change: **Immolate**, a **Shadow Bolt** while your mana is nearly full, then the wand, while the Imp throws **Firebolt**.
press: Send the Imp in, then **Immolate** the mob.
**Shadow Bolt** while you have more than 80% of your mana: about one per mob.
Your wand for the rest.
notes: **Summon Imp** (1) before the first pull: its **Firebolt** casts by itself. Keep **Demon Skin** up at all times, from here to 20.
The fight lab gives you a wand from level 1. Buy one as soon as you can: until then **Shadow Bolt** is the filler too.

stages.title: Corruption, the pull
stages.change: **Corruption** is your pull. From here the dots and the wand do the work, and **Shadow Bolt** waits for a nearly full mana bar.
press: **Corruption** to pull (Mouse 4: the macro sends your demon too), on a mob above about a third of its health.
**Immolate** while you have more than half your mana.
Your wand until the mob dies. **Shadow Bolt** only above 80% of your mana.
notes: **Life Tap** (6): between fights, turn health into mana until you have about 70% of your mana, while your health stays above 60%. The next pull then starts with mana, and you rest the health back.
**Curse of Weakness** (4) is not part of the list.

stages.title: Bane of Agony, and Fear while the Imp cannot tank
stages.change: **Bane of Agony** joins **Corruption**. **Fear** what reaches you: the Imp cannot hold a mob.
press: **Corruption** to pull, then **Bane of Agony**, each on a mob above about a third of its health.
**Immolate** while you have more than half your mana.
**Fear** the mob when it reaches you, and wand it while it runs.
Your wand until the mob dies.
notes: The fight lab casts **Fear** about once a mob at these levels: the Imp's **Firebolt** deals damage but holds nothing. The Voidwalker arrives at 10.

stages.title: The Voidwalker tanks
stages.change: **Summon Voidwalker**: it holds the mob while you dot and wand. Talent points start.
press: Send the Voidwalker in with **Corruption** (Mouse 4), on a mob above about a third of its health; its **Torment** holds the mob.
**Bane of Agony** on a mob above about a third of its health.
**Immolate** while you have more than half your mana.
Your wand until the mob dies.
stages.if_hurt: A mob on you: **Fear** it and wand it while it runs, until the Voidwalker takes it back. Your Healthstone below 35% health.
notes: **Summon Voidwalker** costs a Soul Shard: **Drain Soul** (10) a mob as it dies to get one (Shift+Mouse 4). The fight lab does not count shards; keep two or three in your bags for the demon and your Healthstone.
Heal the Voidwalker between fights with **Consume Shadows** (18, its own spell, not usable in a fight) or **Health Funnel** (12). Check that its **Torment** is on autocast on the pet bar.
**Shadow Bolt** waits for 80% of your mana from here on. With the dots and the wand you rarely have that much past the first pull after a rest, so the fight lab casts few.
**Drain Life** (14) goes on R: from 28 it is the answer after **Fear**.

**Unholy Power** (10-14) adds 10% to the Voidwalker's damage, **Demonic Energies** (15, 19) heals it for 15% of your spell damage and **Improved Voidwalker** (16-17, 24) makes **Torment** and **Consume Shadows** 30% stronger. **Fel Vitality** (18, 20-21) gives the Voidwalker 15% more health and mana and you 15% more mana, **Demonic Embrace** (22-23) adds 6% to your Stamina and **Demonic Aegis** (25-26) makes **Demon Armor** 30% stronger. The leveling filler passes of 2026-11-20 and 2026-11-21 moved three points into **Fel Vitality** (0.1-0.2% faster per kill each) and Improved Imp's three points, which only strengthen the Imp, into **Demonic Embrace** and **Improved Voidwalker** (no slower).
**Demonic Sacrifice** (27) is only the step to **Soul Link** at 30: never sacrifice your tank.
**Demon Armor** (20) replaces **Demon Skin**. **Rain of Fire** (20) is for packs: one mob at a time never needs it. **Searing Pain** (18) waits for **Demonic Brand** at 28.

stages.title: Demonic Brand: Searing Pain for the Voidwalker
stages.change: **Demonic Brand** (talent): **Searing Pain** brands the mob, and the Voidwalker's next 2 attacks (4 from 29, 6 from 34) deal extra damage each, 65 to 68 at level 60.
press: Send the Voidwalker in with **Corruption** (Mouse 4), on a mob above about a third of its health; its **Torment** holds the mob.
**Searing Pain** whenever the brand is gone, the Voidwalker is hitting the mob, the mob has more than a third of its health and you have more than 30% of your mana.
**Bane of Agony** on a mob above about a third of its health.
**Immolate** only while you have more than half your mana: rare from here, since the brand costs mana.
Your wand until the mob dies.
stages.if_hurt: A mob on you: **Fear** it, then **Drain Life** while it runs, until the Voidwalker takes it back. Your Healthstone below 35% health.
notes: **Soul Link** (30): click it once after every summon. 30% of the damage you take goes to the Voidwalker, and you both deal 3% more.
**Demonic Knowledge** (31-33) adds spell damage and **Master Demonologist** (40-41) cuts the physical damage you take, both only while the Voidwalker is out: never fight without it.
**Improved Corruption** (35-39) shortens **Corruption**'s cast by 0.4 seconds a point and adds 2% a point to its damage: **Corruption** is instant from 39.
**Searing Pain** is no finisher here: the tuned rules cast it only on a mob above a third of its health. **Banish** (28) holds a second mob if it is a demon or an elemental.

stages.title: Death Coil
stages.change: **Death Coil** for a mob that reaches you while you are hurt. The rest stays.
press: Send the Voidwalker in with **Corruption** (Mouse 4), on a mob above about a third of its health; its **Torment** holds the mob.
**Searing Pain** whenever the brand is gone, the Voidwalker is hitting the mob, the mob has more than a third of its health and you have more than 30% of your mana.
**Bane of Agony** on a mob above about a third of its health.
Your wand until the mob dies.
stages.if_hurt: A mob on you: **Death Coil** below 60% health, otherwise **Fear** it, then **Drain Life** while it runs. Your Healthstone below 35% health.
notes: **Immolate** only while you have more than half your mana, which the brand almost never leaves you: the fight lab casts it on fewer than one mob in twenty from here.
**Howl of Terror** (40) fears every mob near you: the escape from a pull that brings friends (Shift+F).

With the Voidwalker out, **Master Demonologist** (42-43) cuts the physical damage you and it take by 8%. **Improved Life Tap** (45-46) adds 20% to each **Life Tap**; **Suppression** (44, 47-49) gives 4% hit and cuts your threat by 16%.

stages.title: Amplify Curse
stages.change: **Amplify Curse** (talent) makes the next **Bane of Agony** 50% stronger, every 3 minutes. One macro casts both.
press: Send the Voidwalker in with **Corruption** (Mouse 4), on a mob above about a third of its health; its **Torment** holds the mob.
**Searing Pain** whenever the brand is gone, the Voidwalker is hitting the mob, the mob has more than a third of its health and you have more than 30% of your mana.
**Bane of Agony** with key 1's macro (it adds Amplify Curse when that is ready), on a mob above about a third of its health.
Your wand until the mob dies.
stages.if_hurt: A mob on you: **Death Coil** below 60% health, otherwise **Fear** it, then **Drain Life** while it runs. Your Healthstone below 35% health.
notes: **Amplify Curse** (50): the next **Bane of Agony** is 50% stronger, every 3 minutes. It is off the global cooldown, so the macro on key 1 casts it and the bane in one press when it is ready, and the plain bane otherwise.
**Improved Bane of Agony** (51-52), **Pandemic** (53-54, 59) and **Malevolence** (55-58) make your dots hit harder and crit more often and harder.

stages.title: Siphon Life
stages.change: **Siphon Life** (talent): a third dot that heals you.
press: Send the Voidwalker in with **Corruption** (Mouse 4), on a mob above about a third of its health; its **Torment** holds the mob.
**Searing Pain** whenever the brand is gone, the Voidwalker is hitting the mob, the mob has more than a third of its health and you have more than 30% of your mana.
**Bane of Agony** (key 1's macro) and **Siphon Life** on a mob above about a third of its health.
**Life Tap** in a fight only when you are short of mana and above 60% health.
Your wand until the mob dies.
stages.if_hurt: A mob on you: **Death Coil** below 60% health, otherwise **Fear** it, then **Drain Life** while it runs. Your Healthstone below 35% health.
notes: The third dot costs mana: the fight lab casts **Life Tap** in about one fight in seventeen at 60. The talent gives you **Siphon Life**'s first rank: buy its other ranks at the trainer when you take it.

between: **Life Tap** back to about 70% mana while your health stays above 60%. Your health comes back while you rest, and the Voidwalker takes the next mob.
Eat only below 55% of your health. Drink only below 15% of your mana, when you are too hurt to **Life Tap**: the fight lab needs almost no drinking.

Whenever you sit down to drink, eat as well if your health is not full, and drink while you eat if your mana is not full: the other bar fills in the same seconds at no extra time. Stand up once the bar you sat down for is full. This build seldom sits down, so it saves almost nothing (under 0.3% per kill in the fight lab, 2026-11-16), but it never costs time.
Heal a Voidwalker below 60% of its health with **Consume Shadows** (not usable in a fight), or with **Health Funnel** when it is below half.
Keep two or three Soul Shards: **Drain Soul** a dying mob for one. **Summon Voidwalker** and **Create Healthstone** use one each, and a new Voidwalker costs one when the old one dies.
Visit the trainer every even level for new ranks of your dots.
other: Affliction and Destruction level with lists of their own: their guides are in this folder, and the leveling index ranks the specs by time per kill.
The Affliction/Demonology hybrid plays this same Demonology list with other talents: its guide is in this folder too.

keys.intro: Your two action bars, slot by slot: bar 1 is Q, E, R, F, Mouse 5, Mouse 4, 1, 2, 3, 4, C and the middle mouse button; bar 2 is the same keys with Shift, and Shift+X in the last slot. Keys are for spells you press in a fight and for the things that help you there; armor, summons, Soul Link, conjured stones, food, drink, the mount and the Hearthstone have no key, you click them between fights. The scheme is the same on every class: Q your bolt, E the control, R the payoff after it, F the save, the thumb buttons the reactions and the pull, 1-4 the rest, the middle mouse button the wand. A key keeps its job from 1 to 60 and only the spell on it changes. Bold marks what arrives in that stage. Free slots stay free until something earns them. Setup and macros: the [warlock keybinds page](keybinds.md), written for this guide.

slots.role: The payoff after Fear: drain the mob while it runs; your heal
The save: a horror and a heal in one press
Thumb: the brand, each time it drops
Thumb: the pull, with your demon
Mana: in a fight when short, and between fights

bars.title: Action bar 2: the same keys with Shift (a second mob, the pet, packs)

slots.role: Control a second mob, a demon or an elemental
Escape from a pack: fear every mob near you
Finish a mob for a Soul Shard
Free (a healing potion: the macro page)
Free (a mana potion: the macro page)

notes: Q keeps **Shadow Bolt** in every warlock spec. Demonology casts it only above 80% of its mana, mostly on the first pull after a rest: from level 4 the wand on the middle mouse button is your most-pressed key.
Mouse 4 starts every fight from level 4: a macro that sends your demon and casts **Corruption** (the keybinds page). At 1-3, send the Imp from the pet bar and open with **Immolate** on 2.
E then R answers a mob that reaches you: **Fear** it, then **Drain Life** while it runs. From 42 **Death Coil** on F comes first when you are below 60% health.
Mouse 5 holds **Searing Pain** from 28: press it each time the brand drops. Key 1 becomes the Amplify Curse macro at 50.

No key: **Demon Skin** and **Demon Armor**, **Summon Imp** and **Summon Voidwalker**, **Soul Link**, **Create Healthstone**, food, drink, the mount and the Hearthstone. Put them on a side bar and click them between fights. The Voidwalker's **Torment** casts by itself; **Consume Shadows** and **Sacrifice** stay on the pet bar.
Every warlock guide in this folder keeps these keys for the spells it shares with Demonology, so the keys feel the same whichever spec you level; each guide's notes name the few keys it changes.

guides.intro: What an Affliction warlock presses from level 1 to 60, stage by stage. Affliction levels on its damage-over-time spells and the wand while the Voidwalker (from 10) holds the mob: **Corruption**, **Bane of Agony** and **Immolate** on every healthy mob, **Siphon Life** from 34, and from 40 **Wrack**, whose channel makes your other dots tick twice as fast. You never cast **Shadow Bolt** once you own a wand: the fight lab's re-tune of 2026-11-16 measured every level faster without it (a bolt hardly shortens the fight, and the mana it costs took 3 to 10 seconds of drinking a kill to win back at levels 10-30). Each stage lists the full priority, so you can jump in at your level.

stages.title: Immolate and the wand
stages.change: **Immolate**, then the wand, while the Imp throws **Firebolt**.
press: Send the Imp in, then **Immolate** the mob.
Your wand until it dies.
notes: **Summon Imp** (1) before the first pull: its **Firebolt** casts by itself. Keep **Demon Skin** up at all times, from here to 20.

The fight lab gives you a wand from level 1. Buy one as soon as you can: until then cast Shadow Bolt, the only time this guide does: with a wand, the fight lab never casts **Shadow Bolt** (it measured slower at every level, 6% at level 1).

stages.title: Corruption, the pull
stages.change: **Corruption** is your pull, on every mob.
press: **Corruption** to pull (Mouse 4: the macro sends your demon too), on a mob above about a third of its health and while you have more than 15% of your mana.
**Immolate** on a mob above about half its health, while you have more than half your mana.
Your wand while the dots finish the mob.
notes: **Life Tap** (6): between fights, turn health into mana until you have about 70% of your mana, while your health stays above 60%. The next pull then starts with mana, and you rest the health back.
**Curse of Weakness** (4) is not part of the list.

stages.title: Bane of Agony
stages.change: **Bane of Agony** joins **Corruption**. The Imp cannot hold a mob, so it comes to you: keep casting.
press: **Corruption** to pull, then **Bane of Agony**, each on a mob above about a third of its health.
**Immolate** on a mob above about half its health, while you have more than half your mana and the mob is not yet hitting you.
Your wand while the dots finish the mob, also once it has reached you.
notes: No **Fear** when the mob reaches you: at level 8 the fight lab killed 3% faster dotting and wanding it where it stands (you eat a little more between fights instead). The Voidwalker arrives at 10.

stages.title: The Voidwalker tanks: three dots and the wand
stages.change: **Summon Voidwalker** holds the mob; you dot it and wand it from range. Talent points start.
press: Send the Voidwalker in with **Corruption** (Mouse 4), on a mob above about a third of its health and while you have more than 15% of your mana; its **Torment** holds the mob.
**Bane of Agony** on a mob above about a third of its health.
**Immolate** on a mob above about half its health, while you have more than half your mana.
Your wand while the dots finish the mob.
stages.if_hurt: A mob on you: keep dotting and wanding until the Voidwalker's **Torment** takes it back. Your Healthstone below 35% health.
notes: **Summon Voidwalker** costs a Soul Shard: **Drain Soul** (10) a mob as it dies to get one (Shift+Mouse 4). The fight lab does not count shards; keep two or three in your bags for the demon and your Healthstone.
Heal the Voidwalker between fights with **Consume Shadows** (18, its own spell, not usable in a fight) or **Health Funnel** (12). Check that its **Torment** is on autocast on the pet bar.

**Improved Life Tap** (10-11) adds 20% to every **Life Tap**. **Suppression** (12-15, 31) gives up to 5% hit and cuts your threat by up to 20%, so the Voidwalker keeps the mob. **Improved Corruption** (16-19, 23) shortens **Corruption**'s cast; it is instant from 23.

No **Shadow Bolt** here either: at level 10 the fight lab killed 15% faster without it. A bolt hardly shortens a fight the Voidwalker holds, and the mana it costs took 3 seconds of drinking a kill to win back.
**Drain Life** (14) goes on R: your heal in a fight.

stages.title: Amplify Curse
stages.change: **Amplify Curse** (talent) on the first **Bane of Agony** every 3 minutes. **Drain Life** heals you when you are hurt.
press: Send the Voidwalker in with **Corruption** (Mouse 4), on a mob above about a third of its health and while you have more than 15% of your mana; its **Torment** holds the mob.
**Bane of Agony** with key 1's macro (it adds Amplify Curse when that is ready), on a mob above about a third of its health.
**Immolate** on a mob above about half its health, while you have more than half your mana.
Your wand while the dots finish the mob.
stages.if_hurt: Below 60% health: **Drain Life**, and in place of the wand below 85%. Your Healthstone below 35% health.
notes: **Amplify Curse** (20): the next **Bane of Agony** is 50% stronger, every 3 minutes. It is off the global cooldown, so the macro on key 1 casts it and the bane in one press when it is ready, and the plain bane otherwise.
**Demon Armor** (20) replaces **Demon Skin**. **Rain of Fire** (20) is for packs: one mob at a time never needs it.
**Improved Bane of Agony** (21-22) adds 10% to the bane. **Pandemic** (24, 28, 30) and **Malevolence** (25-27, 29, 44) make your dots crit more often and harder.

stages.title: Wrack
stages.change: **Wrack** (talent): a 6-second channel that makes your other dots tick twice as fast while it lasts. **Immolate** drops out: **Wrack** spends that mana.
press: Send the Voidwalker in with **Corruption** (Mouse 4), on a mob above about a third of its health and while you have more than 15% of your mana; its **Torment** holds the mob.
**Bane of Agony** (key 1's macro) and **Siphon Life** on a mob above about a third of its health.
**Wrack** (Mouse 5) once **Corruption** is up, on a mob above a quarter of its health, while you have more than 30% of your mana.

It is the build's most valuable talent at 60: about 6.5 seconds a kill.
The 30% mana rule: the re-tune of 2026-11-16 measured it about 3% faster per kill than channelling whenever you can.
**Immolate** keeps its rule (above half your mana), but after the three dots and **Wrack** the fight lab never has that much mana from 40: key 2 goes quiet.
**Howl of Terror** (40) fears every mob near you: the escape from a pull that brings friends (Shift+F).

The 14 Demonology points are for the Voidwalker and for you: **Unholy Power** (45-48, 60) adds 10% to its damage, **Demonic Energies** (49-50) heals it for 15% of your spell damage and gives it all the mana of each **Life Tap**, **Improved Voidwalker** (53-55) makes **Torment** and **Consume Shadows** 30% stronger and **Demonic Embrace** (42-43, 56, 59) adds 12% to your Stamina. **Bane** (58) takes 0.1 seconds off **Immolate**'s cast. The leveling filler passes of 2026-11-20 to 2026-11-23 moved the points that measured nothing into these, no slower in the fight lab.

guides.intro: What a Destruction warlock presses from level 1 to 60, stage by stage. Destruction levels as a nuker behind the Voidwalker (from 10), and your wand is the filler: between casts you wand the mob. **Immolate**, **Bane of Agony** on every pull from 8, **Shadow Bolt** only while you have more than 60% of your mana and the mob has more than 35% of its health, **Shadowburn** (29) to finish and **Conflagrate** on its cooldown from 39 (the talent comes at 31, but until **Shadow and Flame** is 5/5 it uses up your **Immolate**, so it waits). No **Corruption**, no **Fear** and no **Drain Life**: the tuned rules level faster without them. Each stage lists the full priority, so you can jump in at your level.

stages.title: Immolate and Shadow Bolt
stages.change: **Immolate**, then **Shadow Bolt** as long as you have more than 60% of your mana; the Imp throws **Firebolt**. No Affliction dots in this list.
press: Send the Imp in, then **Immolate** the mob above 30% of its health.
**Shadow Bolt** while you have more than 60% of your mana and the mob has more than 35% of its health.
Your wand otherwise, and to finish it.

notes: **Summon Imp** (1) before the first pull: its **Firebolt** casts by itself. Keep **Demon Skin** up at all times, from here to 20.

**Life Tap** (6): between fights, turn health into mana until you have about 70% of your mana, while your health stays above 60%. The next pull then starts with mana, and you rest the health back.
**Corruption** (4) and **Fear** (8) are not part of this list; **Fear** still gets a key (E) for a pull that brings a second mob. **Bane of Agony** (8) joins the list then.

stages.title: Bane of Agony
stages.change: **Bane of Agony** (8) goes on every mob while it has more than 35% of its health: the tuned rules force it from 8 (by hand, 2026-11-23: 11.6-12.5% faster a kill at 8-9 in the fight lab).
press: Send the Imp in, then **Bane of Agony** (1) on a mob above 35% of its health.
**Immolate** the mob above 30% of its health.
**Shadow Bolt** while you have more than 60% of your mana and the mob has more than 35% of its health.
Your wand otherwise, and to finish it.
stages.if_hurt: A mob on you: wand it until it dies; nothing hits hard at these levels.
notes: **Bane of Agony** is one instant cast a kill. The tuned rules put it at the top of the list (from 20 since 2026-11-22; from 8 by hand since 2026-11-23: 11.6-12.5% faster a kill at 8-9, 3-8% at 10-19 and 5-9% at 20-30 than without it) and cast it only on a mob above 35% of its health (1.2-1.4% faster than casting it lower).

stages.title: The Voidwalker tanks, the wand fills below 60% mana
stages.change: **Summon Voidwalker** holds the mob while you nuke. Talent points start: **Bane** makes your casts faster.
press: Send the Voidwalker in and open with **Shadow Bolt** (Mouse 4's macro) while its **Torment** takes the mob, then **Bane of Agony** on a mob above 35% of its health and **Immolate** on a mob above 30%, once it will not pull the mob off the Voidwalker.
Between casts your wand is the filler: **Shadow Bolt** only while you have more than 60% of your mana and the mob has more than 35% of its health.
stages.if_hurt: A mob on you: wand it until the Voidwalker's taunt takes it back; a cast in melee gets pushed back. Your Healthstone below 35% health.
notes: **Summon Voidwalker** costs a Soul Shard: **Drain Soul** (10) a mob as it dies to get one (Shift+Mouse 4). The fight lab does not count shards; keep two or three in your bags for the demon and your Healthstone.
Heal the Voidwalker between fights with **Consume Shadows** (18, its own spell, not usable in a fight) or **Health Funnel** (12). Check that its **Torment** is on autocast on the pet bar.

**Bane** (10-14) takes 0.5 seconds off **Shadow Bolt** and **Immolate**, **Destructive Reach** (15-16) adds 20% to the range of your Destruction spells (start the pull a little farther out) and **Cataclysm** (17-19) makes your Destruction spells 10% cheaper.

From 10 to 19 the wand does 35-36% of your damage, **Shadow Bolt** 16-22% and **Bane of Agony** 18-19% (the fight lab, 2026-11-23). The list casts **Shadow Bolt** only while you have more than 60% of your mana: the wand costs nothing, and every bolt's mana has to be drunk back after the fight, so below that line the wand kills faster overall (the re-tune of 2026-11-21: 3% faster per kill over levels 20-60). No **Life Tap** in a fight: with the bolt kept for spare mana the fight lab never runs short.
**Drain Life** (14) and **Searing Pain** (18) are not part of this list: the tuned rules measured faster kills without them.

stages.title: Ruin and Demon Armor

From 20 to 28 the wand does 38-43% of your damage, **Shadow Bolt** 16% and **Bane of Agony** 16% (the fight lab, 2026-11-23).
**Demon Armor** (20) replaces **Demon Skin**. **Rain of Fire** (20) is for packs: one mob at a time never needs it.

stages.title: Shadowburn
stages.change: **Shadowburn** (talent) finishes a mob instantly. Cast it only when it will kill: the Soul Shard comes back.
press: **Shadowburn** on a mob it would kill.

Send the Voidwalker in and open with **Shadow Bolt** (Mouse 4's macro) while its **Torment** takes the mob, then **Bane of Agony** on a mob above 35% of its health and **Immolate** on a mob above 30%, once it will not pull the mob off the Voidwalker.

**Bane of Havoc** (30) is the step to **Incinerate** (40), which the tuned rules never cast: this list fights one mob at a time, so **Bane of Havoc** does nothing here.

stages.title: Conflagrate, held until 39
stages.change: **Conflagrate** (talent): an instant hit on a burning mob every 10 seconds. Until **Shadow and Flame** is 5/5 (39) it uses up your **Immolate**, so hold it until then. The rest stays.
press: **Shadowburn** on a mob it would kill.

Send the Voidwalker in and open with **Shadow Bolt** (Mouse 4's macro) while its **Torment** takes the mob, then **Bane of Agony** on a mob above 35% of its health and **Immolate** on a mob above 30%, once it will not pull the mob off the Voidwalker.
Between casts your wand is the filler: **Shadow Bolt** only while you have more than 60% of your mana and the mob has more than 35% of its health.
stages.if_hurt: A mob on you: **Shadowburn** if it would kill, otherwise wand it until the Voidwalker's taunt takes it back. Your Healthstone below 35% health.
notes: Why it waits: before **Shadow and Flame** 5/5 a **Conflagrate** ends the **Immolate** it hits, and the burn is worth more than the hit. Pressing it even in **Immolate**'s last 3 seconds costs 5.2% a kill at 31, 6.3% at 33, 4.3% at 35 and 0.5% at 38 (the fight lab, 2026-11-23, 3,000 fights on each of two seeds).
**Fire and Brimstone** (32-34) adds 25% critical strike chance to **Conflagrate**, from 39 when you start pressing it.

From 31 to 38 the wand does 44% of your damage, with **Shadow Bolt** at 4% at most (the fight lab, 2026-11-23). The list keeps **Shadow Bolt** for when you have more than 60% of your mana and spends the rest on **Immolate**, **Bane of Agony** and **Shadowburn**: the wand costs nothing, and a bolt's mana has to be drunk back, so the re-tune of 2026-11-21 measured level 35 18% faster per kill that way (44.7 to 36.5 seconds) than bolting through it.

press: **Shadowburn** on a mob it would kill.

**Shadow and Flame** also adds 20% to your Fire damage for 20 seconds after a **Shadowburn**.

stages.title: Conflagrate on cooldown, the wand on a burning mob

press: **Shadowburn** on a mob it would kill.

Send the Voidwalker in and open with **Shadow Bolt** (Mouse 4's macro) while its **Torment** takes the mob, then **Bane of Agony** on a mob above 35% of its health and **Immolate** on a mob above 30%, once it will not pull the mob off the Voidwalker.
**Conflagrate** (R) whenever it is ready, on a burning mob above a fifth of its health.

Between casts your wand is the filler, on a burning mob too: from 40 the list casts **Shadow Bolt** only before **Immolate** is on the mob, while you have more than 60% of your mana and the mob has more than 35% of its health.
stages.if_hurt: A mob on you: **Shadowburn** if it would kill, **Conflagrate** if it is ready, otherwise wand it until the Voidwalker's taunt takes it back. Your Healthstone below 35% health.
notes: **Incinerate** (40): the tuned rules never cast it. From 40 the list wands a burning mob instead of casting a bolt at it: about half a **Shadow Bolt** a kill from here, and 5-12% faster per kill at levels 40-60 than bolting the burning mob (a check on 2026-11-07, 400 fights a level). The fight lab plays that only because the build holds **Incinerate**, which the tuned rules never cast; in game you can wand a burning mob without the talent.
**Aftermath**'s first point (41) adds 10% to **Immolate**'s first hit and gives **Conflagrate** a 20% chance to daze the mob.
**Howl of Terror** (40) fears every mob near you: the escape from a pull that brings friends (Shift+F).

stages.title: Death Coil, the save
stages.change: **Death Coil** (F) is the save for a mob that reaches you while you are hurt: the fight lab presses it about once in 33 kills. The rest stays.
press: **Shadowburn** on a mob it would kill.

Send the Voidwalker in and open with **Shadow Bolt** (Mouse 4's macro) while its **Torment** takes the mob, then **Bane of Agony** on a mob above 35% of its health and **Immolate** on a mob above 30%, once it will not pull the mob off the Voidwalker.
**Conflagrate** whenever it is ready, on a burning mob above a fifth of its health.

Between casts your wand is the filler, on a burning mob too: from 40 the list casts **Shadow Bolt** only before **Immolate** is on the mob, while you have more than 60% of your mana and the mob has more than 35% of its health.
stages.if_hurt: A mob on you below 60% health: **Death Coil** (F), and let the Voidwalker's taunt take it back. Otherwise **Shadowburn** or **Conflagrate** if ready, else wand it until the Voidwalker's taunt takes it back. Your Healthstone below 35% health.
notes: No **Life Tap** in a fight: the fight lab almost never needs one (0.06 a kill at 50-60), since the wand costs nothing.

**Suppression** (42-45) gives 4% hit and cuts your threat by 16%, so the Voidwalker keeps the mob. **Aftermath** (41, 46-49) adds 50% to **Immolate**'s first hit and makes **Conflagrate** daze the mob. From 50 to 58, **Unholy Power** (50-54), **Improved Voidwalker** (55), **Demonic Energies** (56-57) and **Fel Vitality** (58) make the Voidwalker hit harder and last longer, and **Improved Life Tap** (59-60) adds 20% to the mana of **Life Tap**.

between: **Life Tap** back to about 70% mana while your health stays above 60%. Your health comes back while you rest, and the Voidwalker takes the next mob.
Eat only below 40% of your health (the tuned rule of 2026-11-07). Drink only below 15% of your mana, when you are too hurt to **Life Tap**.

Whenever you sit down to drink, eat as well if your health is not full, and drink while you eat if your mana is not full: the other bar fills in the same seconds at no extra time. Stand up once the bar you sat down for is full. It was 2.5% faster per kill for this build in the fight lab (2026-11-16), and the tuned rules play it.
Heal a Voidwalker below 60% of its health with **Consume Shadows** (not usable in a fight), or with **Health Funnel** when it is below half.
Keep two or three Soul Shards: **Drain Soul** a dying mob for one. **Summon Voidwalker** and **Create Healthstone** use one each; a killing **Shadowburn** gives its shard back.

keys.intro: Your two action bars, slot by slot: bar 1 is Q, E, R, F, Mouse 5, Mouse 4, 1, 2, 3, 4, C and the middle mouse button; bar 2 is the same keys with Shift, and Shift+X in the last slot. Keys are for spells you press in a fight and for the things that help you there; armor, summons, Soul Link, conjured stones, food, drink, the mount and the Hearthstone have no key, you click them between fights. The scheme is the same on every class: Q your bolt, E the control, R the payoff after it, F the save, the thumb buttons the reactions and the pull, 1-4 the rest, the middle mouse button the wand. A key keeps its job from 1 to 60 and only the spell on it changes. Bold marks what arrives in that stage. Free slots stay free until something earns them. Setup and macros: the [warlock keybinds page](keybinds.md), written for Demonology; this guide changes the keys its notes name.

notes: Every spell Destruction shares with Demonology keeps its key from the [keybinds page](keybinds.md): Q **Shadow Bolt**, 2 **Immolate**, E **Fear**, F **Death Coil**, 4 **Life Tap**, C the Healthstone, the wand on the middle mouse button.

Mouse 4's pull macro casts **Shadow Bolt** in place of **Corruption** from 10: the fight lab opens with a bolt while the Voidwalker takes the mob, then **Bane of Agony** and **Immolate**. 1 holds **Bane of Agony** from 8, as in the other specs; 3 stays free.

R holds **Conflagrate** from 31, where it waits until **Shadow and Flame** is 5/5 (39): the tuned rules never cast **Drain Life**, so Demonology's R is free here. Mouse 5 holds **Shadowburn** from 29, the finisher.
**Fear** keeps E for a pull that brings a second mob. The tuned rules of 2026-11-07 never cast it against one mob.

No key: **Demon Skin** and **Demon Armor**, **Summon Imp** and **Summon Voidwalker**, **Create Healthstone**, food, drink, the mount and the Hearthstone. Put them on a side bar and click them between fights. The Voidwalker's **Torment** casts by itself; **Consume Shadows** and **Sacrifice** stay on the pet bar.

guides.intro: What the Affliction/Demonology hybrid (27 Affliction and 24 Demonology points) presses from level 1 to 60. It plays the Demonology list without the brand: the Voidwalker (from 10) holds the mob, **Corruption**, **Bane of Agony**, **Immolate** and from 30 **Siphon Life** tick, and the wand does the rest. The Affliction points come first (levels 10-36) and make your dots stronger; the Demonology points (37-60) make the Voidwalker stronger and end in **Soul Link** (57) and **Demonic Knowledge** (58-60). Each stage lists the full priority, so you can jump in at your level.

stages.title: Immolate, Shadow Bolt and the Imp
stages.change: **Immolate**, a **Shadow Bolt** while your mana is nearly full, then the wand, while the Imp throws **Firebolt**.
press: Send the Imp in, then **Immolate** the mob.
**Shadow Bolt** while you have more than 80% of your mana: about one per mob.
Your wand for the rest.
notes: **Summon Imp** (1) before the first pull: its **Firebolt** casts by itself. Keep **Demon Skin** up at all times, from here to 20.
The fight lab gives you a wand from level 1. Buy one as soon as you can: until then **Shadow Bolt** is the filler too.

stages.title: Corruption, the pull
stages.change: **Corruption** is your pull. From here the dots and the wand do the work, and **Shadow Bolt** waits for a nearly full mana bar.
press: **Corruption** to pull (Mouse 4: the macro sends your demon too), on a mob above about a third of its health.
**Immolate** while you have more than half your mana.
Your wand until the mob dies. **Shadow Bolt** only above 80% of your mana.
notes: **Life Tap** (6): between fights, turn health into mana until you have about 70% of your mana, while your health stays above 60%. The next pull then starts with mana, and you rest the health back.
**Curse of Weakness** (4) is not part of the list.

stages.title: Bane of Agony, and Fear while the Imp cannot tank
stages.change: **Bane of Agony** joins **Corruption**. **Fear** what reaches you: the Imp cannot hold a mob.
press: **Corruption** to pull, then **Bane of Agony**, each on a mob above about a third of its health.
**Immolate** while you have more than half your mana.
**Fear** the mob when it reaches you, and wand it while it runs.
Your wand until the mob dies.
notes: The fight lab casts **Fear** about once a mob at these levels: the Imp's **Firebolt** deals damage but holds nothing. The Voidwalker arrives at 10.

stages.title: The Voidwalker tanks
stages.change: **Summon Voidwalker**: it holds the mob while you dot and wand. Talent points start: Affliction until 36, for your dots.
press: Send the Voidwalker in with **Corruption** (Mouse 4), on a mob above about a third of its health; its **Torment** holds the mob.
**Bane of Agony** on a mob above about a third of its health.
**Immolate** while you have more than half your mana.
Your wand until the mob dies.
stages.if_hurt: A mob on you: **Fear** it and wand it while it runs, until the Voidwalker takes it back. Your Healthstone below 35% health.
notes: **Summon Voidwalker** costs a Soul Shard: **Drain Soul** (10) a mob as it dies to get one (Shift+Mouse 4). The fight lab does not count shards; keep two or three in your bags for the demon and your Healthstone.
Heal the Voidwalker between fights with **Consume Shadows** (18, its own spell, not usable in a fight) or **Health Funnel** (12). Check that its **Torment** is on autocast on the pet bar.
**Shadow Bolt** waits for 80% of your mana from here on. With the dots and the wand you rarely have that much past the first pull after a rest, so the fight lab casts almost none.
**Drain Life** (14) goes on R: from 20 it is the answer after **Fear**.

**Improved Life Tap** (10-11) adds 20% to every **Life Tap**. **Suppression** (12-15, 33) gives up to 5% hit and cuts your threat by up to 20%, so the Voidwalker keeps the mob. **Improved Corruption** (16-19, 23) shortens **Corruption**'s cast; it is instant from 23.
**Searing Pain** (18) stays off your bars: the Demonology list casts it for Demonic Brand, a talent this build does not take, and the fight lab casts almost none.

stages.title: Amplify Curse
stages.change: **Amplify Curse** (talent) makes the next **Bane of Agony** 50% stronger, every 3 minutes. One macro casts both.
press: Send the Voidwalker in with **Corruption** (Mouse 4), on a mob above about a third of its health; its **Torment** holds the mob.
**Bane of Agony** with key 1's macro (it adds Amplify Curse when that is ready), on a mob above about a third of its health.
**Immolate** while you have more than half your mana.
Your wand until the mob dies. **Shadow Bolt** only above 80% of your mana.
stages.if_hurt: A mob on you: **Fear** it, then **Drain Life** while it runs, until the Voidwalker takes it back. Your Healthstone below 35% health.
notes: **Amplify Curse** (20): the next **Bane of Agony** is 50% stronger, every 3 minutes. It is off the global cooldown, so the macro on key 1 casts it and the bane in one press when it is ready, and the plain bane otherwise.
**Demon Armor** (20) replaces **Demon Skin**. **Rain of Fire** (20) is for packs: one mob at a time never needs it. **Banish** (28) holds a second mob if it is a demon or an elemental.
**Improved Bane of Agony** (21-22) adds 10% to the bane. **Pandemic** (24, 28) and **Malevolence** (25-27, 29) make your dots crit more often and harder.

stages.title: Siphon Life
stages.change: **Siphon Life** (talent): a third dot that heals you.
press: Send the Voidwalker in with **Corruption** (Mouse 4), on a mob above about a third of its health; its **Torment** holds the mob.
**Bane of Agony** (key 1's macro) and **Siphon Life** on a mob above about a third of its health.
**Immolate** while you have more than half your mana.
Your wand until the mob dies.
stages.if_hurt: A mob on you: **Fear** it, then **Drain Life** while it runs, until the Voidwalker takes it back. Your Healthstone below 35% health.
notes: The third dot costs mana: **Life Tap** between fights, and in a fight only when you are short of mana and above 60% health. **Shadow Bolt** waits for 80% of your mana, which the three dots no longer leave you: the fight lab casts almost none from here.

**Pandemic** (31) and **Malevolence** (32) take their last points: your dots' critical strikes hit harder, and your Shadow spells crit 5% more often. **Suppression** (33) completes 5% hit and 20% less threat.

**Soul Siphon** (34) is the 25th Affliction point, which opens **Shadow Mastery** (35-36: 4% more Shadow damage); it only strengthens **Drain Life** and **Drain Soul** here, which this list rarely casts.
The Demonology points start at 37: **Unholy Power** (37-41) adds 10% to the Voidwalker's damage.
**Howl of Terror** (40) fears every mob near you: the escape from a pull that brings friends (Shift+F).

stages.title: Death Coil
stages.change: **Death Coil** for a mob that reaches you while you are hurt. The rest stays.
press: Send the Voidwalker in with **Corruption** (Mouse 4), on a mob above about a third of its health; its **Torment** holds the mob.
**Bane of Agony** (key 1's macro) and **Siphon Life** on a mob above about a third of its health.
**Immolate** while you have more than half your mana.
Your wand until the mob dies.
stages.if_hurt: A mob on you: **Death Coil** below 60% health, otherwise **Fear** it, then **Drain Life** while it runs. Your Healthstone below 35% health.
notes: **Immolate** only while you have more than half your mana: with no brand to pay for, the fight lab casts it on about three mobs in four from here.

**Demonic Energies** (42, 46) heals the Voidwalker for 15% of your spell damage and gives it the mana of each **Life Tap**; **Fel Vitality** (43-45) gives your demon 15% more health and mana, and you 15% more mana.

**Demonic Sacrifice** (47) is only the step to **Soul Link**: never sacrifice your tank. **Improved Voidwalker** (48-49) makes **Torment** and **Consume Shadows** 20% stronger (the filler pass of 2026-11-23 moved Improved Imp's two points there, no slower). **Demonic Aegis** (50, 52) only fills a tier: its stronger **Demon Armor** measured nothing in the fight lab, where the Voidwalker takes the hits. **Demonic Embrace** (51, 53-56) adds 15% to your Stamina.

**Soul Link** (57): click it once after every summon. 30% of the damage you take goes to the Voidwalker, and you both deal 3% more. **Demonic Knowledge** (58-60) adds a third of your level a point to your spell damage while the Voidwalker is out: never fight without it.

between: **Life Tap** back to about 70% mana while your health stays above 60%. Your health comes back while you rest, and the Voidwalker takes the next mob.
Eat only below 55% of your health. Drink only below 15% of your mana, when you are too hurt to **Life Tap**: the fight lab needs almost no drinking.

Whenever you sit down to drink, eat as well if your health is not full, and drink while you eat if your mana is not full: the other bar fills in the same seconds at no extra time. Stand up once the bar you sat down for is full. This build seldom sits down, so it saves almost nothing, but it never costs time.
Heal a Voidwalker below 60% of its health with **Consume Shadows** (not usable in a fight), or with **Health Funnel** when it is below half.
Keep two or three Soul Shards: **Drain Soul** a dying mob for one. **Summon Voidwalker** and **Create Healthstone** use one each, and a new Voidwalker costs one when the old one dies.
Visit the trainer every even level for new ranks of your dots.
other: This hybrid plays the Demonology list with Affliction's dot talents first and the Voidwalker's talents after. The Demonology and Affliction guides in this folder show the two specs it is made of; the leveling index ranks the specs by time per kill.

notes: The Demonology layout of the [keybinds page](keybinds.md), with one change: this build takes no Demonic Brand, so Mouse 5 stays free where Demonology keeps **Searing Pain**. The Amplify Curse macro takes key 1 at 20 and **Siphon Life** key 3 at 30, when this build takes them.
Q keeps **Shadow Bolt**, cast only above 80% of your mana: the wand on the middle mouse button is your most-pressed key from level 4.
E then R answers a mob that reaches you: **Fear** it, then **Drain Life** while it runs. From 42 **Death Coil** on F comes first when you are below 60% health.
**Health Funnel** on Shift+R heals the Voidwalker between fights, as in Demonology: this build has no Improved Health Funnel, and the fight lab never channels it in a fight.

No key: **Demon Skin** and **Demon Armor**, **Summon Imp** and **Summon Voidwalker**, **Soul Link**, **Create Healthstone**, food, drink, the mount and the Hearthstone. Put them on a side bar and click them between fights. The Voidwalker's **Torment** casts by itself; **Consume Shadows** and **Sacrifice** stay on the pet bar.
